snippet.title: Lizards Must Die 2 Console Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
LIZARDS MUST DIE 2 is a cooperative slasher action game, a high–quality continuation of the SENSATIONAL first part. Insidious lizards attacked the lands of the Rus again. HYPERBOREA is on fire and only the GLORIOUS HEROES can kick the invaders from their homeland. 

The game is coming this yeat to PS5/PS4 and XBOX
